name: tap-target
title: Tap Target
description: Feature discovery: a large circle expands around an element to introduce it.
improvements: role="dialog" labelled by its title; focus moves to the text and back to where it was.
Escape and outside clicks close it; it follows its target on scroll and resize.
Keeps Materialize's quadrant placement but clamps the text inside the viewport on small screens.
Controlled or uncontrolled open state and reduced-motion support.
